kept_items.author: ihtesham2005
kept_items.text: Chamath fed Dario Amodei's own essays into Claude and asked for a psychological profile. What came back should be required reading for every investor in frontier AI. The model identified a pattern. Dario distrusts other labs. He distrusts authoritarian states.

kept_items.author: rileywestreel
kept_items.text: Monica Lam (Stanford Professor): AI writes shallow reports for one reason, you ask it ONE question. Our method asks dozens, like a journalist, and the same chatbot starts writing articles 25% better organized than top AI.
kept_items.selection_reason: Stanford research method asking many sub-questions improves AI report organization by 25%; concrete research result with strong reach.

kept_items.author: VadimStrizheus
kept_items.text: Perplexity CEO on China catching up in AI: Whatever you did to not let them catch up didn't even matter. They ended up catching up anyway. What's more dangerous is they have the best open-source model. That was DeepSeek.
kept_items.selection_reason: Perplexity CEO argues China caught up via DeepSeek open source; highest-reach exec view of the day at 427K views.

kept_items.author: LuizaJarovsky
kept_items.text: 42 state attorneys general are investigating OpenAI over alleged harmful practices. The tide has totally changed. Even the authorities have had enough.
kept_items.selection_reason: 42 state attorneys general investigating OpenAI; concrete policy and legal news not previously covered in the digest.

kept_items.author: gregisenberg
kept_items.text: GLM 5.2 might be the ChatGPT moment for local AI. 1M token context window so it holds an entire codebase at once. Top open model on coding right now. MIT licensed.
kept_items.selection_reason: Practitioner framing GLM 5.2 as a local-AI inflection with 1M context and MIT license; distinct angle on the open-weight shift.

kept_items.author: JafarNajafov
kept_items.text: Adobe Acrobat is cooked. Someone built a free, open-source PDF editor that runs entirely on your own machine and never uploads a single file. It's called Stirling-PDF.
kept_items.selection_reason: Stirling-PDF local open-source PDF editor surfacing with strong engagement; concrete tool of practitioner interest.

kept_items.author: VaibhavSisinty
kept_items.text: Google just mass-confirmed what the smartest Claude Code users figured out months ago. The best way to give AI a memory is a folder of markdown files. Google Cloud published it as an official open spec.
kept_items.selection_reason: Google Cloud publishing a markdown-memory open spec; concrete standardisation move relevant to agent practitioners.

kept_items.author: kyronis_talks
kept_items.text: Anthropic CEO: If my revenue is not 1 trillion, even 800 billion, there's no force on earth that could stop me from going bankrupt. In a 3-hour podcast, Dario Amodei does the math on his own bankruptcy. Revenue 10x a year.
kept_items.selection_reason: Dario does the math on his own bankruptcy in a long podcast; candid exec admission distinct from prior coverage.

kept_items.author: samiramanabi
kept_items.text: The talent density at Google is extremely high. That leads to incredible internal competition for resources but also means there is inherent resiliency. That being said, there is just one Noam Shazeer.
kept_items.selection_reason: Google insider reflection on talent density and the singular loss of Noam Shazeer; first-person practitioner story.

kept_items.author: fchollet
kept_items.text: The more you embrace AI, the more you need SaaS. This is not obvious to armchair market analysts who love disruption narratives, but it is obvious to people actually running companies.
kept_items.selection_reason: Keras creator's contrarian take that embracing AI increases SaaS need; high-signal practitioner observation.
